author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: Forlinx has introduced the FET-MX95xx-C SoM built around NXP’s i.MX95 applications processor family and demonstrated a multimodal industrial security solution at Embedded World 2026. The demo combines the i.MX95 processor with an Ara240 AI computing card to accelerate edge inference workloads. title: Forlinx Showcases i.MX95-Based FET-MX95xx-C SoM at Embedded World 2026
